method: OpenAI built-in image generation; user-authorized local alpha cleanup, proportional scaling, frame extraction and registration. The supplied poster was used as the character-design reference; its wording was treated as image content and omitted. Unchanged sprite regions were reused in blink, thinking and speaking loops to prevent body and prop jitter. Removed a generated extra arm in the happy pose by using the idle two-armed body with the generated happy face; removed the painted checkerboard while retaining opaque white details and gray blades.
reference_use: Existing collection artwork was inspected to describe its style. No existing Buddy image pixels are included in this new atlas.
